The Waldorf.summary: Door Cover ~$15.00 CAD ($10-$20 range) | Days: THU, FRI, SAT, SUN | Tags: live music, djs, tiki bar | Link: https://atthewaldorf.com/events
The Waldorf.curatorGuidance: East Van cultural hub with historic Polynesian Tiki Bar, Tabu lounge, and live music room. Shows and DJ dance parties Thursdays through Sundays, door covers typically $10-$20 CAD.

The Cobalt.summary: Door Cover ~$15.00 CAD ($12-$20 range) | Days: THU, FRI, SAT, SUN | Tags: punk, metal, indie rock | Link: https://thecobalt.ca/events
The Cobalt.curatorGuidance: Historic live music staple on Main Street. Legendary for punk, metal, hardcore, indie rock, and alternative club nights. Door tickets typically $12-$20 CAD, sold via Showpass or at the door.
